cache (dict): An optional mapping from source object IDs to remapped
            objects. A new cache is created by default. Passing a cache allows
            traversable objects shared across calls to be remapped only once.
            Keep the source objects alive while reusing their cache, since
            object IDs may otherwise be reused by Python.
